thread_text:
Maya (PM): Quick huddle: Sales wants a compact launch checklist for Starter + surge add-on. Need owners and max three go/no-go gates each. Keep it tight for the Friday partner sync.
Ethan (Eng): Engineering gates proposal: 1) quota enforcement at ingress (reject vs queue behavior defined), 2) perf regression test: p95 within +20ms in staging, 3) burst isolation verified across 10 synthetic tenants.
Rosa (RevOps): Sales pilot ask: Starter baseline 40k tokens/mo, surge add-on = 150k tokens/mo softcap. Pilot customers must opt into auto-overage. Need clear SKU naming and migration plan.
Noah (SRE): Rollout plan: canary 2% (low QPS) -> 20% -> 100%. Observability: events pricing.tier_assigned, pricing.surge_start, pricing.surge_end, billing.preview_requested. Alerts when a tenant consumes >75% of surge allowance in 30m.
Priya (Legal): Include pilot opt-in clause and trial grace language. For GA auto-billing allowed but require conspicuous opt-out at sign-up. Also require invoice dispute window (30 days).
Maya (PM): Action items: Ethan writes quota YAML and perf harness, Rosa drafts SKU & migration notes + sample invoice, Noah writes rollout + alerts, Priya drafts pilot clause. I'll compile one-pager. Deadline: Thursday EOD.
billing-bot: Sample invoice preview: https://billing.redwood.example/preview?sku=starter-surge-overage :mag:
Rosa (RevOps): Quick note: Sales needs self-serve toggle for surge per account but disabled by default; add manual enable path for pilots.
Ethan (Eng): Agreed. I'll include a gateway feature flag and a safe-fallback to post-hoc billing during early rollout.
Maya (PM): Great. I'll send the one-pager to Sales and Legal when you all confirm owners. :thumbsup:
